name: f3
argv:
set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
hostname
uname -r
doas -n vm list
swapinfo -k
sysctl -n hw.physmem hw.ncpu hw.pagesize vm.stats.vm.v_free_count vm.stats.vm.v_inactive_count vm.stats.vm.v_free_target vm.stats.vm.v_swappgsin vm.stats.vm.v_swappgsout
sysctl -n vm.loadavg
doas -n mdconfig -l
mount -p
for dataset in zroot/bhyve/homelabfs-lab/hfs-test0 zroot/bhyve/homelabfs-lab/hfs-test1 zroot/bhyve/homelabfs-lab/hfs-test2 zroot/bhyve/freebsd; do
  doas -n zfs get -Hp -o name,property,value guid "$dataset@zrepl_20261029_050719_000"
  doas -n zfs get -Hp -o name,property,value written@zrepl_20261029_050719_000 "$dataset"
done

name: rocky
argv: ProxyCommand=/usr/bin/ssh -F /dev/null -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o UpdateHostKeys=no -o ControlMaster=no -o ControlPath=none -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o ServerAliveInterval=3 -o ServerAliveCountMax=1 -o UserKnownHostsFile=/home/paul/tmp/codex/hfs-native-planning-20261029/yq3/host-known_hosts -W %h:%p paul@f3

/usr/bin/timeout -k 2s 25s /bin/sh -c 'set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
hostname
uname -r
id -u
cat /etc/rocky-release
printf '"'"'system_state='"'"'
systemctl is-system-running || true
printf '"'"'sshd_state='"'"'
systemctl is-active sshd
systemctl --failed --no-legend --no-pager
printf '"'"'boot_id='"'"'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '"'"'boot_time='"'"'
uptime -s
printf '"'"'RPM_MANIFEST_BEGIN\n'"'"'
rpm -qa --qf '"'"'%{NAME}-%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}.%{ARCH}\n'"'"' | LC_ALL=C sort
printf '"'"'RPM_MANIFEST_END\n'"'"'
'
